text.hi: किताब के पेज 80-81 पर कविता ‘Lohri’ पढ़ो। फिर जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Kitaab ke page 80-81 par kavita ‘Lohri’ padho. Phir jawab do.
text.en: Read the poem ‘Lohri’ on pages 80–81 of your book. Then answer.

steps.question: What is the poem about?

questionMeaning.hi: यह कविता किसके बारे में है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Yeh kavita kiske baare mein hai?

options: the festival of Lohri and a better way to celebrate it
steps.answer: the festival of Lohri and a better way to celebrate it
steps.modelAnswer: The poem is about the festival of Lohri. It also tells us a better way to celebrate it without harming the environment.

modelMeaning.hi: यह कविता लोहड़ी के त्योहार के बारे में है। यह पर्यावरण को नुक़सान पहुँचाए बिना इसे मनाने का बेहतर तरीका भी बताती है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Yeh kavita Lohri ke tyohaar ke baare mein hai. Yeh paryaavaran ko nuksaan pahunchaaye bina ise manaane ka behtar tareeka bhi bataati hai.

steps.question: How are the days in the South during January?

questionMeaning.hi: जनवरी में दक्षिण में दिन कैसे होते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: January mein dakshin mein din kaise hote hain?

steps.modelAnswer: The days in the South are fine during January.

modelMeaning.hi: जनवरी में दक्षिण में दिन अच्छे होते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: January mein dakshin mein din achhe hote hain.

steps.question: Why do people collect twigs and leaves?

questionMeaning.hi: लोग टहनियाँ और पत्ते क्यों इकट्ठा करते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Log tahniyaan aur patte kyon ikattha karte hain?

options: to make a big bonfire for Lohri
steps.answer: to make a big bonfire for Lohri
steps.modelAnswer: People collect twigs, leaves and wood to make a big pile for the Lohri bonfire.

modelMeaning.hi: लोग लोहड़ी के अलाव के लिए टहनियाँ, पत्ते और लकड़ी इकट्ठा करते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Log Lohri ke alaav ke liye tahniyaan, patte aur lakdi ikattha karte hain.

steps.question: What goes from hand to hand?

questionMeaning.hi: हाथ से हाथ क्या जाता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Haath se haath kya jaata hai?

steps.modelAnswer: Nuts and sweetmeats pass from hand to hand.

modelMeaning.hi: मेवे और मिठाइयाँ हाथ से हाथ जाती हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Meve aur mithaaiyaan haath se haath jaati hain.

steps.question: What, according to the poet, is not good for the environment?

questionMeaning.hi: कवि के अनुसार पर्यावरण के लिए क्या अच्छा नहीं है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kavi ke anusaar paryaavaran ke liye kya achha nahi hai?

options: Bonfires burn a lot of wood and the smoke pollutes the air.
steps.answer: Bonfires burn a lot of wood and the smoke pollutes the air.
steps.modelAnswer: According to the poet, bonfires are not good for the environment. They burn a lot of wood and the smoke pollutes the air.

modelMeaning.hi: कवि के अनुसार अलाव पर्यावरण के लिए अच्छे नहीं। इनमें बहुत लकड़ी जलती है और धुएँ से हवा गंदी होती है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Kavi ke anusaar alaav paryaavaran ke liye achhe nahi. Inmein bahut lakdi jalti hai aur dhuein se hawa gandi hoti hai.

steps.question: How can Lohri be celebrated in a better way?

questionMeaning.hi: लोहड़ी को बेहतर तरीके से कैसे मनाया जा सकता है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Lohri ko behtar tareeke se kaise manaaya ja sakta hai?

options: by burning our hatred instead of wood
steps.answer: by burning our hatred instead of wood
steps.modelAnswer: Lohri can be celebrated in a better way by burning our hatred instead of wood.

modelMeaning.hi: लकड़ी की जगह अपनी नफ़रत जलाकर लोहड़ी बेहतर तरीके से मनाई जा सकती है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Lakdi ki jagah apni nafrat jalaakar Lohri behtar tareeke se manaayi ja sakti hai.

text.hi: अब किताब का दूसरा भाग: कविता की लाइन के लिए सही शब्द चुनो।
text.hinglish: Ab kitaab ka doosra bhaag: kavita ki line ke liye sahi shabd chuno.
text.en: Now part B: pick the right word for each line of the poem.

steps.question: Soon we have a great small / big pile.
The flame will leap up / down high.
Bonfires consume a lot of / a little wood.
Yet there must be a good / better way.

text.hi: अब छूटी हुई लाइनें (किताब का भाग C)।
text.hinglish: Ab chhooti hui lines (kitaab ka bhaag C).

steps.question: Bonfires consume a lot of wood, ... (next line)
options: For the environment this is not so good.
Nuts and sweetmeats make the ornaments,
steps.answer: For the environment this is not so good.

steps.question: Let's burn our hatred instead of wood ... (next line)
options: And send it up in flames for good.
steps.answer: And send it up in flames for good.
